vendor/ffmpeg = @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 (dist/esm), MIT License, https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
vendor/util   = @ffmpeg/util 0.12.2 (dist/esm), MIT License, https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
The FFmpeg WebAssembly core (@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10) is NOT hosted here; it is loaded at runtime
from cdn.jsdelivr.net (fallback unpkg.com). FFmpeg itself: https://ffmpeg.org (LGPL/GPL).
